steps.title: Resolve or escalate
steps.goal: Help with the issue if you are sure of the answer; otherwise apologise sincerely and escalate it to the senior team for a quick resolution.

steps.title: Meeting slot
steps.goal: Ask when the seller is free for a short meeting with an IndiaMART representative (day + time).

steps.title: Paid subscription benefits
steps.goal: Explain paid-plan benefits: many more BuyLeads to grow the business, better search visibility, TrustSEAL/verified badge, dedicated support.

steps.title: Catalog gap
steps.goal: Ask whether any new products should be added.

steps.title: Open conversation
steps.goal: Answer IndiaMART questions; only the seller ends the call.

talkingPoints: Consumes BuyLeads in: Basmati Rice, Mobile Phones, Men Jeans, Power Bike, TMT Steel Bars, 1121 Basmati Rice, Kamdhenu TMT Bars — pitch more leads in these categories.

Products with a price get more buyer enquiries than those without.

Buyer calls reach the seller through the PNS (Preferred Number Service) number.

turns.text: जी, Equinox के नाम से आपकी GL ID जनरेट हो गई है। अब बताइए, आप Power Bike या Royal Enfield के लिए कोई BuyLeads मिस कर रही थीं क्या?
